Chaque palier a un **seuil en pourcentag: Each tier has a **threshold as a percentage of the goal** (for example, 80%), an optional condition, and actions, such as the events described below.
Chaque tâche accomplie donne des points: Each completed task earns points (**Merit 10**, **Merit 20**…) via a button, an interaction, or a scenario.
Chaque évènement a une **condition** fac: Each event has an optional **condition**. If it is false, the entire event is ignored. If it is left blank, the event always runs.
Chaque évènement contient une ou plusieu: Each event contains one or more **actions**. For each one, you can choose an action command (list button) or a scenario keyword: message, variable, scenario, wait, alert… (keyword button).

L'intérêt est de simplifier les scénario: The goal is to simplify scenarios. Instead of writing a condition that must know the status of all relevant elements, each scenario simply adds or removes its points. All the logic of “what happens when the threshold is crossed” is consolidated in a single place: the Méritant device.
Le but est le seuil d'entretien (par exe: The goal is the maintenance threshold (for example, 50 cycles).
Le log `deserve` indique, en niveau **in: The `deserve` log reports, at the **info** level, every time the goal is met. At the **debug** level, it also details every value change, every evaluated condition, and every action executed.
Le plugin **Mérite** est un sémaphore po: The **Merit** plugin is a semaphore for Jeedom. Each device, called a “Meritorious Device,” has a counter and a target. Scenarios or actions add points (**Merit**) or subtract points (**Demerit**). When the counter reaches the target, the device becomes “Merit-worthy” and its merit-granting actions are executed. When it falls below the target, it is no longer “Merit-worthy” and its demerit-granting actions are executed.
Le plugin n'a ni dépendance ni démon. Il: The plugin has no dependencies or daemons. Just activate it.
Le seuil étant exprimé en pourcentage, l: Since the threshold is expressed as a percentage, the threshold levels automatically adjust when the target changes. Lowering the target can also cause a threshold level to be crossed.
Les **actions déméritantes** s'exécutent: **Demerit actions** are executed when the counter **falls below** the target (*Is Meritorious* changes from 1 to 0).
Les **actions méritantes** s'exécutent q: **Merit actions** are triggered when the counter **reaches or exceeds** the target (*Is Meritorious* changes from 0 to 1).
Les actions ne s'exécutent qu'au **franc: Actions are only triggered when the **goal is met**. Adding points to a device that has already earned them does not trigger the actions again.
Les paliers permettent de déclencher des: Checkpoints allow you to trigger actions **before** reaching the goal, for example, to notify you that a maintenance task is coming up.
Les sliders du widget vont de 0 à 100. D: The widget's sliders range from 0 to 100. From within a scenario, you can send a higher value (for example, *Must Require* set to 150).
Les évènements sont exécutés dans l'ordr: Events are executed in the order displayed, and so are the actions for each event. Actions can be reordered using the handle.
Mérite et Démérite sans valeur, ou avec: Merits and demerits with a value of zero have no effect.
Nettoyage du code et version minimale Je: Code cleanup and minimum version of Jeedom 4.3
On veut éviter que trop de gros consomma: We want to avoid having too many high-power appliances running at the same time: oven, washing machine, dryer, dishwasher, and charging station.
Option « Remise à zéro » par équipement,: "Reset" option for each device, without triggering any adverse actions
Paliers configurables en pourcentage du: Configurable thresholds as a percentage of the target
Pour chaque appareil, un petit scénario: For each device, a small scenario awards **1 Merit** when its power exceeds a threshold and **1 Demerit** when it drops below it. You can apply a weighting: the terminal can count as 2.
Pour le filtre d'une VMC, d'un adoucisse: For the filter in a mechanical ventilation system, water softener, or range hood, or the dustbin of a robot vacuum.
Sauvegarde des évènements et refonte de: Event backup and redesign of the equipment layout
Si on baisse le but en dessous de la val: If the target is lowered below the current value, the value is adjusted to the new target. It is not restored if the target is subsequently raised.
Si plusieurs paliers sont franchis d'un: If multiple levels are triggered at once, they are executed from the lowest to the highest, and always before the corresponding actions.
Si rien n'est indiqué, il s'agit probabl: Unless otherwise noted, this is likely a minor update to correct spelling or ensure compatibility with Jeedom V4.x

Un palier s'exécute quand le pourcentage: A step is executed when the percentage crosses its threshold **on the way up**. If it drops back below the threshold and then rises again, the step is executed once more.
Un palier à 80 % envoie une notification: When the level reaches 80%, a notification is sent stating, “Maintenance will be required soon.”
Un scénario hebdomadaire fait **Mise à z: A weekly scenario performs a **reset** to start over from scratch.
Un seuil au-dessus de 100 % est possible: A value above 100% is possible, since the value can exceed the target.
Une action peut être désactivée sans êtr: You can disable an action without deleting it by unchecking its box.
